title: Dev-Team Installation Manifest Schema
description: Validates provenance tracking manifest at .dev-team/installation-manifest.json or ~/.dev-team/manifest.json

dev_team_version.description: Dev-Team version that created or updated the installation

platform.description: Primary platform adapter configured (e.g. codex, claude-code)

installed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of installation or last update

artifacts.description: Registry of all files and projections managed by Dev-Team

path.description: Relative or target filesystem path of the managed artifact

strategy.description: Technique used to install or project the file

source.description: Source origin path of canonical file (e.g. in ~/.dev-team/)

source_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonical source file for drift detection

managed_by_dev_team.description: Whether this file is tracked and safely uninstalled/updated by Dev-Team

user_modified.description: Whether user edits have been detected to prevent silent overwrite
